item.content:encoded:
WrenCore WrenCore-v0.1.0

WrenCore is a library for defining and evaluating probabilistic models, which aims to allow users to write performant models with natural modelling syntax. It is part of the Wren probabilistic programming library: see https://juliabayes.org/Wren.jl/ for more information.

Closed issues:

  • Plate primitive & subsampling (#1)
  • Use BangBang (#2)
  • Think harder about getting submodel latents (#3)
  • Avoid collecting submodel trace if not needed (#5)
  • Think about parameters vs params (#6)
  • Nicer print for VecModel (#7)
  • Figure out the replacement for AbstractMCMC, including progress logging (#8)
  • Two-level submodel nesting fails under Enzyme reverse mode (IllegalTypeAnalysisException) (#10)
  • Indexed needs to be dim-aware (#11)
  • Reactant path: stale ext helper names, Distributions logpdf not traceable, reactant tests not run (#12)
  • Sample within plates is very slow (#14)
  • @plate crashes on user-defined functions on the right-hand side (#17)
  • predict: a verb for posterior prediction from a chain (#18)
  • Documentation: It might be useful to document the issue with Distributions and Reactant (#20)
  • Enzyme runtime activity issues (#21)
  • Reenable GitHub CI once it's public (#22)
  • DI prep doesn't seem to make Enzyme actually compile stuff (#23)
  • Handle ADTypes.NoAutoDiff (#26)
  • Enzyme docs page (#27)
  • Reactant docs page (#28)
  • Dirichlet errors (#30)
  • Handle and/or document UndefVarErrors (#31)
  • Figure out a way to build a compute graph (#32)
  • Submodel recompilation during prior sampling (#36)
  • VecModel construction fails for models containing a submodel (#37)

  • Implement @sample name=... x ~ dist and the corresponding @observe (#44)
  • Intermittent PartialArray range lookup error for plated sites under threaded chains (#45)
  • @plate fails on keyword arguments in the right-hand-side call (#46)
  • nuts: chains fail to start when DynamicHMC's default init lands on zero density — initialise from the prior? (#47)

  • Rename plate (#66)
  • Try to avoid copying model args on evaluation (#69)

  • Vendor PM functionality (#85)

  • DiagNormal (#99)
  • Batched Bernoulli (#102)

  • Batched Poisson (#104)
  • Batched Exponential (#105)
  • Batched LogNormal (#106)

  • Batched Categorical (#112)
  • BatchedIsoLogNormal (#115)

  • TDist + batched version (#117)
  • NegativeBinomial + batched (#118)

  • Batched Beta (#120)
  • Batched Weibull (#121)

  • Benchmark half-dists (#128)
  • Enzyme failure with deepcopied Int (#132)
  • Better debug logs (#136)

  • Optimise PosteriorDB benchmarks (#144)
  • Per-thread model copies don't copy model args (#146)

  • Auto-optimise model (#153)
  • Improve argument copy elision by considering only differentiable data (#154)

  • @Batch uses the wrong indices in its generic fallback (#157)
  • @Batch changes density at boundaries and outside support (#158)
  • Poisson sampling hangs at large Float32 rates (#159)

  • Scalar Gamma throws for negative observations (#248)
